title: Aztec crash possibly brought down by the lashup radar network
summary: UAPGerb tells of Aztec crash possibly brought down by the lashup radar network, about 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh one of the prevailing theories is that the uh the lashup radar network which was constructed over uh New Mexico to protect against Soviet bomber attacks

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb talks about a craft said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948. He says one of the main theories is that it was brought down by the lashup radar network, an early chain of radar stations built over New Mexico to guard against Soviet bomber attacks. If true, it would mean military radar could knock such craft out of the sky.
